name: summary filters exposure and missing metrics only
test:
import math
rows = [{'variant':'A','exposed':True,'metric':10.0}, {'variant':'A','exposed':True,'metric':10.0}, {'variant':'B','exposed':True,'metric':15.0}, {'variant':'B','exposed':True,'metric':15.0}, {'variant':'B','exposed':False,'metric':1000.0}, {'variant':'A','exposed':True,'metric':None,'country':'US'}]
summary = ab_summary(rows)
assert math.isclose(summary['lift'], 0.5)
assert 0.0 <= summary['p_value'] <= 1.0

name: segment reports are pre-aggregated and safe for missing groups
test:
import math
rows = [{'variant':'A','exposed':True,'metric':2.,'country':'US'}, {'variant':'A','exposed':True,'metric':4.,'country':'US'}, {'variant':'B','exposed':True,'metric':6.,'country':'US'}, {'variant':'B','exposed':True,'metric':6.,'country':'US'}]
report = SegmentLiftReport(rows)
assert math.isclose(report.lift('US'), 1.0)
assert math.isnan(report.lift('CA'))
